definitions.explanation: Describes things that are independent or unrelated to each other. Used to emphasize that two or more items should be treated as separate matters.

examples.japanese: ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{別個|べっこ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧だ。
⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{別個|べっこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{扱|あつか}う→扱う：01862_atsukau⟧。
examples.english: We will treat the two incidents separately.

examples.japanese: {別個|べっこ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{組織|そしき}→組織：03320_soshiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かって→向かう：01186_mukau⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Separate organizations are working toward the same goal.

notes:
{別個|べっこ} emphasizes that things are independent and unrelated.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {別個|べっこ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun — a separate [noun]
- {別個|べっこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ + verb — separately, independently

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{別々|べつべつ}→別々：03972_betsubetsu⟧ — separately (emphasizes each one is different; more colloquial)
- ⟦{個別|こべつ}→個別：11566_kobetsu⟧ — individual (emphasizes one-by-one treatment)
- {別個|べっこ} — separate, distinct (emphasizes independence from each other; more formal)
